assumptions.viable_stock: lot quantity > 0 AND the lot's most recent germination_rate >= 75
assumptions.stock_semantics: SeedLot.quantity is current stock AFTER distributions

few_shot_examples.question: List the local names of all pulse varieties.
few_shot_examples.sql: SELECT local_name FROM SeedVariety WHERE crop_type = 'Pulse';

few_shot_examples.question: How many seed lots are stored at each storage location?
few_shot_examples.sql: SELECT storage_location, COUNT(*) AS lot_count FROM SeedLot GROUP BY storage_location;

few_shot_examples.question: What is the most recent storage temperature recorded for each seed lot?
few_shot_examples.sql: SELECT s.lot_id, s.temperature FROM StorageLog s WHERE s.recorded_date = (SELECT MAX(s2.recorded_date) FROM StorageLog s2 WHERE s2.lot_id = s.lot_id);

few_shot_examples.question: Which varieties have never been distributed?
few_shot_examples.sql: SELECT v.local_name FROM SeedVariety v WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SeedLot l JOIN Distribution d ON d.lot_id = l.lot_id WHERE l.variety_id = v.variety_id);

questions.question: List the crop name and local name of all varieties tagged as highly drought-tolerant.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT crop_name, local_name FROM SeedVariety WHERE drought_tolerance = 'High';

questions.question: Which seed lots are stored in Cold Room A?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT lot_id FROM SeedLot WHERE storage_location = 'Cold Room A';

questions.question: Show the germination tests conducted in 2026 with a germination rate below 75%.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT test_id, lot_id, test_date, germination_rate FROM GerminationTest WHERE test_date >= '2026-01-01' AND test_date < '2027-01-01' AND germination_rate < 75;

questions.question: How many seed varieties are millets?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SeedVariety WHERE crop_type = 'Millet';

questions.question: Which seed lots were collected before 2018?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT lot_id FROM SeedLot WHERE collection_date < '2018-01-01';

questions.question: Which seed lots have run out of stock (zero quantity)?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT lot_id FROM SeedLot WHERE quantity = 0;

questions.question: What is the total available seed quantity in grams at each storage location?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT storage_location, SUM(quantity) AS total_quantity FROM SeedLot GROUP BY storage_location;

questions.question: What is the average germination rate for each year in which tests were conducted?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y', test_date) AS test_year, AVG(germination_rate) AS avg_rate FROM GerminationTest GROUP BY test_year;

questions.question: Which 5 seed lots have been stored outside recommended conditions (temperature above 15 C or humidity above 50%) for the longest time, measured by the number of out-of-range storage readings?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT lot_id, COUNT(*) AS out_of_range_readings FROM StorageLog WHERE temperature > 15 OR humidity > 50 GROUP BY lot_id ORDER BY out_of_range_readings DESC LIMIT 5;

questions.question: Which destinations have received more than 2000 grams of seed in total?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT destination, SUM(quantity) AS total_received FROM Distribution GROUP BY destination HAVING SUM(quantity) > 2000;

questions.question: Which seed lots have been germination-tested 3 or more times, and how many tests does each have?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT lot_id, COUNT(*) AS n_tests FROM GerminationTest GROUP BY lot_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3;

questions.question: How many varieties are there of each crop type and drought-tolerance level?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT crop_type, drought_tolerance, COUNT(*) AS n_varieties FROM SeedVariety GROUP BY crop_type, drought_tolerance;

questions.question: Which seed lots have a most recent germination rate below 75% and need retesting? Show the lot and that latest rate.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT g.lot_id, g.germination_rate FROM GerminationTest g WHERE g.test_date = (SELECT MAX(g2.test_date) FROM GerminationTest g2 WHERE g2.lot_id = g.lot_id) AND g.germination_rate < 75;

questions.question: Which highly drought-tolerant varieties have viable stock available, meaning at least one lot with quantity above zero whose most recent germination rate is at least 75%? Give the local names.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT v.local_name FROM SeedVariety v JOIN SeedLot l ON l.variety_id = v.variety_id JOIN GerminationTest g ON g.lot_id = l.lot_id WHERE v.drought_tolerance = 'High' AND l.quantity > 0 AND g.germination_rate >= 75 AND g.test_date = (SELECT MAX(g2.test_date) FROM GerminationTest g2 WHERE g2.lot_id = l.lot_id);

questions.question: Summarize available seed lots (quantity above zero) by variety local name and storage location, showing the number of lots and the total quantity.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT v.local_name, l.storage_location, COUNT(*) AS n_lots, SUM(l.quantity) AS total_quantity FROM SeedLot l JOIN SeedVariety v ON v.variety_id = l.variety_id WHERE l.quantity > 0 GROUP BY v.local_name, l.storage_location;

questions.question: Which varieties have a germination result below 75% recorded in 2025 or later with no later retest recorded on the same lot? Give the local names.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT v.local_name FROM GerminationTest g JOIN SeedLot l ON l.lot_id = g.lot_id JOIN SeedVariety v ON v.variety_id = l.variety_id WHERE g.germination_rate < 75 AND g.test_date >= '2025-01-01' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM GerminationTest g2 WHERE g2.lot_id = g.lot_id AND g2.test_date > g.test_date);

questions.question: Which storage location's seed lots supplied the largest total quantity of distributed seed, and how much was it?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT l.storage_location, SUM(d.quantity) AS total_distributed FROM Distribution d JOIN SeedLot l ON l.lot_id = d.lot_id GROUP BY l.storage_location ORDER BY total_distributed DESC LIMIT 1;

questions.question: Which varieties have been distributed to more than 3 different destinations? Give the local name and the number of destinations.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT v.local_name, COUNT(DISTINCT d.destination) AS n_destinations FROM Distribution d JOIN SeedLot l ON l.lot_id = d.lot_id JOIN SeedVariety v ON v.variety_id = l.variety_id GROUP BY v.variety_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT d.destination) > 3;

questions.question: For each seed lot, what is its most recent germination rate?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT g.lot_id, g.germination_rate FROM GerminationTest g WHERE g.test_date = (SELECT MAX(g2.test_date) FROM GerminationTest g2 WHERE g2.lot_id = g.lot_id);

questions.question: Which seed lots had their most recent germination test in 2026?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT lot_id FROM GerminationTest GROUP BY lot_id HAVING MAX(test_date) >= '2026-01-01' AND MAX(test_date) < '2027-01-01';

questions.question: Which seed lots have a most recent germination test dated before 2024, so they are overdue for testing? Show the lot and the date of that latest test.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT lot_id, MAX(test_date) AS last_test FROM GerminationTest GROUP BY lot_id HAVING MAX(test_date) < '2024-01-01';

questions.question: Which seed lots have a most recent germination rate of at least 85%?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT g.lot_id FROM GerminationTest g WHERE g.test_date = (SELECT MAX(g2.test_date) FROM GerminationTest g2 WHERE g2.lot_id = g.lot_id) AND g.germination_rate >= 85;

questions.question: Which seed lots lost more than 20 percentage points of germination between their first and their most recent test? Show the lot, the first rate and the latest rate.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT f.lot_id, f.germination_rate AS first_rate, l.germination_rate AS latest_rate FROM GerminationTest f JOIN GerminationTest l ON l.lot_id = f.lot_id WHERE f.test_date = (SELECT MIN(test_date) FROM GerminationTest x WHERE x.lot_id = f.lot_id) AND l.test_date = (SELECT MAX(test_date) FROM GerminationTest y WHERE y.lot_id = l.lot_id) AND f.germination_rate - l.germination_rate > 20;

questions.question: Which seed lots have a most recent germination rate below 75% even though an earlier test was 75% or higher?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT g.lot_id FROM GerminationTest g WHERE g.test_date = (SELECT MAX(g2.test_date) FROM GerminationTest g2 WHERE g2.lot_id = g.lot_id) AND g.germination_rate < 75 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM GerminationTest e WHERE e.lot_id = g.lot_id AND e.test_date < g.test_date AND e.germination_rate >= 75);

questions.question: How many seed lots currently need retesting because their most recent germination rate is below 75%?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM GerminationTest g WHERE g.test_date = (SELECT MAX(g2.test_date) FROM GerminationTest g2 WHERE g2.lot_id = g.lot_id) AND g.germination_rate < 75;

questions.question: Which varieties have at least one lot whose most recent germination rate is below 60%? Give the local names.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT v.local_name FROM GerminationTest g JOIN SeedLot l ON l.lot_id = g.lot_id JOIN SeedVariety v ON v.variety_id = l.variety_id WHERE g.test_date = (SELECT MAX(g2.test_date) FROM GerminationTest g2 WHERE g2.lot_id = g.lot_id) AND g.germination_rate < 60;

questions.question: For each storage location, what is the average of its lots' most recent germination rates?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT l.storage_location, AVG(g.germination_rate) AS avg_latest FROM GerminationTest g JOIN SeedLot l ON l.lot_id = g.lot_id WHERE g.test_date = (SELECT MAX(g2.test_date) FROM GerminationTest g2 WHERE g2.lot_id = g.lot_id) GROUP BY l.storage_location;

questions.question: Which seed lots had any storage reading above 15 C in 2026?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT lot_id FROM StorageLog WHERE temperature > 15 AND recorded_date >= '2026-01-01' AND recorded_date < '2027-01-01';

questions.question: In which months of 2026 was the average storage temperature across all lots above 15 C? Give the month as YYYY-MM and the average.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', recorded_date) AS month, AVG(temperature) AS avg_temp FROM StorageLog WHERE recorded_date >= '2026-01-01' AND recorded_date < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY month HAVING AVG(temperature) > 15;

questions.question: Which seed lots were collected in 2020 or later?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT lot_id FROM SeedLot WHERE collection_date >= '2020-01-01';

questions.question: How many germination tests were conducted in each year from 2024 onwards?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y', test_date) AS yr, COUNT(*) FROM GerminationTest WHERE test_date >= '2024-01-01' GROUP BY yr;

questions.question: Which seed lots had seed distributed in 2026, and how much was distributed from each of them in 2026?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT lot_id, SUM(quantity) AS distributed_2026 FROM Distribution WHERE date >= '2026-01-01' AND date < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY lot_id;

questions.question: Which seed lots were germination-tested in 2025 and not tested again afterwards? Show the lot and the date of that test.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT g.lot_id, g.test_date FROM GerminationTest g WHERE g.test_date >= '2025-01-01' AND g.test_date < '2026-01-01' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM GerminationTest x WHERE x.lot_id = g.lot_id AND x.test_date > g.test_date);

questions.question: How many seed lots are currently out of stock?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SeedLot WHERE quantity = 0;

questions.question: Which seed lots are viable stock, meaning quantity above zero and a most recent germination rate of at least 75%?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT g.lot_id FROM GerminationTest g JOIN SeedLot l ON l.lot_id = g.lot_id WHERE g.test_date = (SELECT MAX(g2.test_date) FROM GerminationTest g2 WHERE g2.lot_id = g.lot_id) AND g.germination_rate >= 75 AND l.quantity > 0;

questions.question: What is the total viable stock in grams for each crop type, counting only lots with quantity above zero and a most recent germination rate of at least 75%?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT v.crop_type, SUM(l.quantity) AS viable_grams FROM GerminationTest g JOIN SeedLot l ON l.lot_id = g.lot_id JOIN SeedVariety v ON v.variety_id = l.variety_id WHERE g.test_date = (SELECT MAX(g2.test_date) FROM GerminationTest g2 WHERE g2.lot_id = g.lot_id) AND g.germination_rate >= 75 AND l.quantity > 0 GROUP BY v.crop_type;

questions.question: Which seed lots are out of stock (zero quantity) even though their most recent germination rate is at least 75%, so the seed is viable but exhausted?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT g.lot_id FROM GerminationTest g JOIN SeedLot l ON l.lot_id = g.lot_id WHERE g.test_date = (SELECT MAX(g2.test_date) FROM GerminationTest g2 WHERE g2.lot_id = g.lot_id) AND g.germination_rate >= 75 AND l.quantity = 0;

questions.question: For each seed lot that has distributions, what is the total quantity distributed and its current stock? Note that the stock in SeedLot is already after distributions.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT l.lot_id, SUM(d.quantity) AS distributed, l.quantity AS current_stock FROM SeedLot l JOIN Distribution d ON d.lot_id = l.lot_id GROUP BY l.lot_id;

questions.question: Which seed lots have distributed more seed in total than they currently hold in stock?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT l.lot_id FROM SeedLot l JOIN Distribution d ON d.lot_id = l.lot_id GROUP BY l.lot_id HAVING SUM(d.quantity) > l.quantity;

questions.question: What was the original quantity of each seed lot that has distributions, that is its current stock plus everything distributed from it?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT l.lot_id, l.quantity + SUM(d.quantity) AS original_quantity FROM SeedLot l JOIN Distribution d ON d.lot_id = l.lot_id GROUP BY l.lot_id;

questions.question: Which storage locations hold at least one lot whose most recent germination rate is below 75%?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT l.storage_location FROM GerminationTest g JOIN SeedLot l ON l.lot_id = g.lot_id WHERE g.test_date = (SELECT MAX(g2.test_date) FROM GerminationTest g2 WHERE g2.lot_id = g.lot_id) AND g.germination_rate < 75;

questions.question: How many out-of-range storage readings (temperature above 15 C or humidity above 50%) were recorded at each storage location?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT l.storage_location, COUNT(*) AS out_of_range FROM StorageLog s JOIN SeedLot l ON l.lot_id = s.lot_id WHERE s.temperature > 15 OR s.humidity > 50 GROUP BY l.storage_location;

questions.question: Which seed lots stored in Cold Room A or Cold Room B have a most recent germination rate below 75%?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT g.lot_id FROM GerminationTest g JOIN SeedLot l ON l.lot_id = g.lot_id WHERE g.test_date = (SELECT MAX(g2.test_date) FROM GerminationTest g2 WHERE g2.lot_id = g.lot_id) AND g.germination_rate < 75 AND l.storage_location IN ('Cold Room A', 'Cold Room B');

questions.question: Which crop names have more than 3000 grams of viable stock in total, counting only lots with quantity above zero and a most recent germination rate of at least 75%?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT v.crop_name, SUM(l.quantity) AS viable_grams FROM GerminationTest g JOIN SeedLot l ON l.lot_id = g.lot_id JOIN SeedVariety v ON v.variety_id = l.variety_id WHERE g.test_date = (SELECT MAX(g2.test_date) FROM GerminationTest g2 WHERE g2.lot_id = g.lot_id) AND g.germination_rate >= 75 AND l.quantity > 0 GROUP BY v.crop_name HAVING SUM(l.quantity) > 3000;

questions.question: For each seed lot with any out-of-range storage reading (temperature above 15 C or humidity above 50%), what is its most recent germination rate?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT g.lot_id, g.germination_rate FROM GerminationTest g WHERE g.test_date = (SELECT MAX(g2.test_date) FROM GerminationTest g2 WHERE g2.lot_id = g.lot_id) AND g.lot_id IN (SELECT lot_id FROM StorageLog WHERE temperature > 15 OR humidity > 50);

questions.question: List each seed lot with its variety's local name and crop name.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT l.lot_id, v.local_name, v.crop_name FROM SeedLot l JOIN SeedVariety v ON v.variety_id = l.variety_id;

questions.question: Which crop names have seed lots stored on the Ambient Shelf?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT v.crop_name FROM SeedLot l JOIN SeedVariety v ON v.variety_id = l.variety_id WHERE l.storage_location = 'Ambient Shelf';

questions.question: Which destinations have received seed of a pulse crop?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT d.destination FROM Distribution d JOIN SeedLot l ON l.lot_id = d.lot_id JOIN SeedVariety v ON v.variety_id = l.variety_id WHERE v.crop_type = 'Pulse';

questions.question: For each crop name, how many seed lots are there?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT v.crop_name, COUNT(*) AS n_lots FROM SeedLot l JOIN SeedVariety v ON v.variety_id = l.variety_id GROUP BY v.crop_name;

questions.question: Which varieties have lots in more than one storage location? Give the local names.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT v.local_name FROM SeedLot l JOIN SeedVariety v ON v.variety_id = l.variety_id GROUP BY v.variety_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.storage_location) > 1;

questions.question: What is the total quantity of seed distributed for each crop type?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT v.crop_type, SUM(d.quantity) AS distributed FROM Distribution d JOIN SeedLot l ON l.lot_id = d.lot_id JOIN SeedVariety v ON v.variety_id = l.variety_id GROUP BY v.crop_type;

questions.question: Which accession numbers have a seed lot stored at Village Hub - Mandya?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT v.accession_number FROM SeedLot l JOIN SeedVariety v ON v.variety_id = l.variety_id WHERE l.storage_location = 'Village Hub - Mandya';

questions.question: How many distinct destinations has each crop type been distributed to?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT v.crop_type, COUNT(DISTINCT d.destination) AS n_destinations FROM Distribution d JOIN SeedLot l ON l.lot_id = d.lot_id JOIN SeedVariety v ON v.variety_id = l.variety_id GROUP BY v.crop_type;

questions.question: What is the average germination rate for each crop type across all tests?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT v.crop_type, AVG(g.germination_rate) AS avg_rate FROM GerminationTest g JOIN SeedLot l ON l.lot_id = g.lot_id JOIN SeedVariety v ON v.variety_id = l.variety_id GROUP BY v.crop_type;

questions.question: Which storage location has the highest average temperature, and what is that average?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT l.storage_location, AVG(s.temperature) AS avg_temp FROM StorageLog s JOIN SeedLot l ON l.lot_id = s.lot_id GROUP BY l.storage_location ORDER BY avg_temp DESC LIMIT 1;

questions.question: What are the minimum and maximum germination rates recorded for each crop name?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT v.crop_name, MIN(g.germination_rate), MAX(g.germination_rate) FROM GerminationTest g JOIN SeedLot l ON l.lot_id = g.lot_id JOIN SeedVariety v ON v.variety_id = l.variety_id GROUP BY v.crop_name;

questions.question: How many distributions went to each destination?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT destination, COUNT(*) FROM Distribution GROUP BY destination;

questions.question: Which crop types have an average current stock per lot above 1500 grams?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT v.crop_type, AVG(l.quantity) AS avg_stock FROM SeedLot l JOIN SeedVariety v ON v.variety_id = l.variety_id GROUP BY v.crop_type HAVING AVG(l.quantity) > 1500;

questions.question: Which seed lot has the largest current stock, and how much is it?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT lot_id, quantity FROM SeedLot ORDER BY quantity DESC LIMIT 1;

questions.question: What is the average humidity of storage readings at each storage location?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT l.storage_location, AVG(s.humidity) FROM StorageLog s JOIN SeedLot l ON l.lot_id = s.lot_id GROUP BY l.storage_location;

schema_text:
SeedVariety(variety_id INTEGER PK, crop_name TEXT, local_name TEXT, crop_type TEXT, drought_tolerance TEXT, accession_number TEXT, genebank TEXT, doi TEXT)
  -- one row per real genebank accession; local_name = accession name (or accession number if unnamed)
  -- crop_type values: 'Cereal','Millet','Oilseed','Pulse'
  -- drought_tolerance values: 'High','Medium'
  -- crop_name values: 'Barnyard millet','Chickpea','Finger millet','Foxtail millet','Groundnut','Kodo millet','Little millet','Pearl millet','Pigeon pea','Proso millet','Sorghum'
  -- doi = the accession's Genesys DOI (e.g. '10.18730/QP1EF')
SeedLot(lot_id INTEGER PK, variety_id INTEGER FK->SeedVariety.variety_id, storage_location TEXT, quantity INTEGER, collection_date TEXT)
  -- storage_location values: 'Ambient Shelf','Clay Pot Store','Cold Room A','Cold Room B','Village Hub - Mandya'
  -- quantity = grams currently in stock, already AFTER all distributions (0 means exhausted); collection_date = date this seed lot was harvested/regenerated
GerminationTest(test_id INTEGER PK, lot_id INTEGER FK->SeedLot.lot_id, test_date TEXT, germination_rate REAL)
  -- germination_rate is a percentage 0-100; a lot can have several tests over time
StorageLog(log_id INTEGER PK, lot_id INTEGER FK->SeedLot.lot_id, recorded_date TEXT, temperature REAL, humidity REAL)
  -- monthly readings; temperature in deg C, humidity in % relative humidity
Distribution(distribution_id INTEGER PK, lot_id INTEGER FK->SeedLot.lot_id, destination TEXT, quantity INTEGER, date TEXT)
  -- seed given out to farmer groups; quantity in grams
Notes: all dates are TEXT 'YYYY-MM-DD'. The database engine is SQLite. Today's date is 2026-11-01.

dataset.note: SeedVariety holds 66 REAL genebank accessions from Genesys (genebank IND002); crop_type and drought tolerance follow a crop-level rule; seed lots, germination tests, storage logs and distributions are simulated (fixed seed) because genebanks do not publish per-lot monitoring records.
